steps.title: Scope and Applicability
steps.instruction: Scope and Applicability: Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid is used during surgical procedures to maintain tissue hydration and minimize tissue damage, adhesion formation and infection.

steps.instruction: KOH can cause burns. Wear proper PPE including gloves and eye protection while handling this chemical. Use this chemical in a fume hood.

steps.title: To make 1000 ml of Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid (ACSF):
steps.instruction: To make 1000 ml of Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid (ACSF):

steps.title: Using a graduated cylinder, measure and...
steps.instruction: Using a graduated cylinder, measure and add 900 ml of MilliQ water to an appropriately labeled RNase free container containing an RNase free stir bar.

steps.title: Place container on stir plate and...
steps.instruction: Place container on stir plate and begin stirring at a high setting (7 or higher).

steps.title: Using a calibrated balance, weigh out 7
steps.instruction: Using a calibrated balance, weigh out 7.889 g of Sodium Chloride (NaCl). Slowly add weighed NaCl to the container while stirring.

steps.title: Using a calibrated balance, weigh out...
steps.instruction: Using a calibrated balance, weigh out 403 mg of Potassium Chloride (KCl). Slowly add weighed KCl to the container while stirring.

steps.title: Using a calibrated balance, weigh out...
steps.instruction: Using a calibrated balance, weigh out 203 mg of Magnesium Chloride (MgCl2). Slowly add weighed MgCl2 to the container while stirring.

steps.title: Using a calibrated balance, weigh out...
steps.instruction: Using a calibrated balance, weigh out 265 mg of Calcium Chloride (CaCl2). Slowly add weighed CaCl2 to the container while stirring.

steps.title: Using a calibrated balance, weigh out 1
steps.instruction: Using a calibrated balance, weigh out 1.192 g of HEPES. Slowly add weighed HEPES to the container while stirring.

steps.title: Continue stirring at a high speed...
steps.instruction: Continue stirring at a high speed (setting 7 or higher) until all of the chemicals are fully in solution.

steps.title: In a fume hood, use a...
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, use a calibrated pH meter to adjust the pH to 7.4 using 1N KOH.

steps.title: A fume hood is required when adjusting pH with KOH
steps.instruction: A fume hood is required when adjusting pH with KOH.

steps.title: Adjust final volume to 1000 ml...
steps.instruction: Adjust final volume to 1000 ml with MilliQ water using the graduation marks on the side of the container (if calibrated) or a graduated cylinder.

steps.title: Remove stir bar using a magnetic stir bar remover
steps.instruction: Remove stir bar using a magnetic stir bar remover.

steps.title: Filter the ACSF through a Corning 1 liter 0
steps.instruction: Filter the ACSF through a Corning 1 liter 0.22 µm filter system.

steps.title: Using Tygon tubing, attach the Corning...
steps.instruction: Using Tygon tubing, attach the Corning filter system to the Gast vacuum pump. Turn on the pump.

steps.title: Filter 500 ml at a time,...
steps.instruction: Filter 500 ml at a time, stirring the remaining ACSF constantly on a stir plate.

steps.title: Label the bottle with reagent name, date and preparer’s initials
steps.instruction: Label the bottle with reagent name, date and preparer’s initials.

steps.title: Can be stored at 4°C and...
steps.instruction: Can be stored at 4°C and used for up to one month.

steps.title: Dispose of excess reagent directly into municipal sewer system
steps.instruction: Dispose of excess reagent directly into municipal sewer system.

steps.title: Wash the stir bar with RNase...
steps.instruction: Wash the stir bar with RNase Away and rinse with MilliQ water.

steps.title: Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid (ACSF) has a...
steps.instruction: Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid (ACSF) has a shelf life of one month at 4°C.

steps.title: The osmolarity of this formulation of...
steps.instruction: The osmolarity of this formulation of ACSF is normally not measured or adjusted. However, if the end user asks that it be made with a specific osmolarity, measure the osmolarity of a 10 µl sample of the solution using an osmometer prior to filtration. If the osmolarity is not in the desired range, adjust as needed.

steps.title: If the osmolarity is too high, add MilliQ water
steps.instruction: If the osmolarity is too high, add MilliQ water.

steps.title: If the osmolarity is too low,...
steps.instruction: If the osmolarity is too low, add a volume (X) of 1 mg/ml NaCl solution determined by the following equation

steps.title: Confirm that the correct osmolarity has...
steps.instruction: Confirm that the correct osmolarity has been reached after addition of NaCl or water.
